voltage-unbalance.description: Voltage unbalance across phases (typically the NEMA definition: max deviation from the average, divided by the average).

thd-voltage-{a,b,c}.description: Total Harmonic Distortion of voltage on the named phase, as a percentage of the fundamental.

thd-current-{a,b,c}.description: Total Harmonic Distortion of current on the named phase, as a percentage of the fundamental.

tdd-current-{a,b,c}.description: Total Demand Distortion of current on the named phase: like THD-current but normalized to the demand interval's peak current rather than the instantaneous fundamental.
